climate_pressure: Dry spells and urban water-supply stress described in KCCA's Kawempe narrative.
documented_impact: Crop and water-access pressures increase reliance on communal points and costly alternatives.
fcv_mediator: Long queues, inadequate storage and unequal household purchasing power.
possible_consequence: The report states queues fuel social tension, without measuring violence incidence.
alternative_explanations: Urban development, groundwater use, storage and service reliability also drive shortages.
uncertainty: Source-stated qualitative mechanism citing older material, not a causal study or current incident census. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: Household adaptation and better storage/service management are relevant capacities, not proven tension reduction.
compact_statement: KCCA describes Kawempe water stress interacting with queues and unequal access to fuel social tension; no violence rate is established.
